metadata.title: That 1 kill where I swear the enemy was glitching through space LOL Valorant logic
metadata.description:
Wait, did that just count as a kill?
Enemy probably blinked out of existence mid-fight.
Click if you’ve ever won a duel you didn’t see coming.
Valorant’s bug or feature? You decide.

Tap if your best kills feel like pure glitches!
